meta_title: Nash Auto Keys | Emergency Locksmith Birmingham
meta_description: Nash Auto Keys in Birmingham specialises in car unlocking, key replacement, and emergency lockout services. Available 24/7 with rapid response times.
hero_subhead: We arrive within 30 minutes across Birmingham. No waiting, no fuss, keys sorted fast.
services_subhead: From emergency car unlocking to replacement keys and lock repairs, we handle everything to get you back on the road.

services.title: Emergency Car Unlocking
services.desc: Locked yourself out? We arrive quickly and unlock your car without damage. Available day and night, every day of the year.

services.title: Replacement Car Keys
services.desc: Lost your keys or need a spare? We cut and programme replacement keys for all makes and models on-site, often while you wait.

services.title: Key Programming
services.desc: Modern cars need coded keys. We programme new keys to your vehicle's security system using specialist equipment and diagnostic tools.

services.title: Broken Key Extraction
services.desc: Snapped your key in the lock or ignition? We safely remove broken pieces and supply you with a working replacement.

services.title: Lock Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Faulty door locks, boot locks, or ignition problems? We repair or replace locks and mechanisms to restore full function.

services.title: Mobile Locksmith Service
services.desc: We come to you. No need to tow your vehicle — our fully equipped van means most jobs are done roadside or at your home.

about_pullquote: I started Nash Auto Keys because I hated the extortionate rates other locksmiths charged.
about_para_1: Nash Auto Keys was founded over 15 years ago in Quinton, Birmingham, with a simple mission: provide honest, fast locksmith help without the shock bill. We've built our reputation by turning up quickly, fixing the problem right, and charging fair prices. Every day we unlock cars, cut keys, and repair locks across Birmingham and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we answer the phone 24/7, arrive when we say we will, and explain what we're doing before we charge you. We don't upsell unnecessary services or drag out jobs. You're in a bind — we get you moving again, and you can trust us to do it right.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Drivers Say About Nash Auto Keys

reviews.text: Locked my keys in the car outside Tesco. Rang Nash Auto Keys at 11pm and they were here in 25 minutes. Friendly lad, had me back in the car in five minutes flat. Charged me £35 — honestly the fairest price I've had. Top job.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Snapped my key in half in the ignition. Thought I was done for. Called them on a Sunday and they came out same day, extracted the broken bits, and made me a new key. Unbelievable service. Wouldn't go anywhere else now.
reviews.author: Rachel K.

reviews.text: Lost my car keys on the motorway, miles from home. Nash Auto Keys came out to my location, cut a replacement key, and programmed it into my car in under an hour. Lifesaver. Never thought I'd be back on the road so quick.
reviews.author: David W.
